children: Finward Bancorp's net interest income rose 10.4% year over year, while earnings declined by $2.1 million. Higher net interest income and margin reflected loan repricing, strong new originations and lower deposit and borrowing costs; lower noninterest income and higher expenses, including $1.8 million in merger-related accrual adjustments and $536,000 in merger advisory costs, weighed on results.
² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Tax-equivalent net interest margin increased to 3.51% from 3.18%, supported by higher asset yields and lower funding costs.
: Loans receivable, net of deferred fees and costs, totaled $1.50 billion at September 30, up from $1.45 billion at year-end 2025.
: Total deposits increased 1.8% to $1.76 billion from December 31, 2025; money market balances rose 13.5%.
: Shareholders approved the First Financial Bancorp merger on November 2; the transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to conditions.
